# IntuitionLabs

> > IntuitionLabs provides AI-driven solutions and expertise for pharmaceutical regulatory affairs, drug development, and healthcare technology innovation.

Founded by Adrien Laurent, IntuitionLabs specializes in regulatory compliance systems (Veeva Vault, eCTD submissions), clinical research operations, and GenAI applications across the life sciences industry. The platform offers consulting, implementation guidance, and industry intelligence for biotech and pharma companies navigating FDA, EMA, and global regulatory requirements.

## Key Topics

- Regulatory Affairs & Compliance
- eCTD (electronic Common Technical Document)
- Veeva Vault & Veeva Vault RIM
- FDA Submissions (NDA, IND, 21 CFR Part 11)
- Drug Discovery & Development
- Pharmacovigilance & Safety Signals
- GCP Guidelines & Clinical Trials
- EMA & Health Canada Regulations
- GenAI in Pharmaceutical Industry
- eQMS & Quality Management Systems
- RIM (Regulatory Information Management)
- Healthcare AI & Innovation
- ICH Guidelines (M2, Q1A)
- Biotech & MedTech Compliance
- ISO 13485 & GxP Standards
